notes.title: New Characters join the ring! + adjustment update
notes.notes:
Digital Crafter’s meme fighter, Fight of Animals has added in 2 new characters today for free. Players will have “Fluffy Sheep” and “Kungfu Dachshund” in the game once they update the game.

[previewyoutube=egIHKjLp334;full]PV Link: [/previewyoutube]

After release Fight of Animals: Arena on last December, Digital Crafter has added in these two characters in FOA: Arena. Digital Crafter has receiving a lot of request that hoping “Fluffy Sheep” and “Kungfu Dachshund” can also be in the original Fight of Animals. Digital Crafter decide to follow players opinion and provide them back as free new characters in Fight of Animals.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/8f6aa0fecf3fb988aadc0cf5fd917a7cd7af5a84.png[/img]

The moves of these two characters are the same as “Fight of Animals: Arena” but has been modify and adjust to fit 1 on 1 game play. Also, there are some new animations add in as well, for example they now have intro and outro animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/a3e6529a196c8dd5055ac5b743e1440e6b9fd78d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/392bd2d22d21e9d536e0d90458acdfa664690ed8.png[/img]
 
The Costume skin for “Fluffy Sheep” and “Kungfu Dachshund” are also included in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/17b522d02d6751abe7a51dd12604078ab14cae01.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/49a3b6643d02c1cb143c34509ae196e7b99adc46.png[/img]

“Fight of Animals” is a fighting game aiming for easy to play and more casual approach, however it still provides some depth and rollback net code. 
The game now has 12 animals in total, its double amount compares when it first came out.

“Fluffy Sheep” and “Kungfu Dachshund” will also add into Switch and PlayStation4 version soon, players can follow Twitter and Discord for further notice.


 (Fight of Animals) Steam：
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160330/Fight_of_Animals/

https://twitter.com/fightofanimals

notes.title: Memes fighting game – Fight of Animals is Now Released.!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Aw40mvo44KM;full][/previewyoutube]

『Fight of Animals』is a 1 vs 1 fighting game. The idea of『Fight of Animals』came from the popular meme pictures from the web. Those pictures were taken by very weird moment, and that make the animal in those pictures looks very funny or weirdly adorable like “Power hook doge”,” Muscle Fox”,” Walking Cat” and” Magic Squirrel”… They all will be the playable characters in the game.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/1b7403c336233d11fb94fbd0a65dbefa4687b3bd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/9beabcfb1a2165087b9e3d61dfbd57cdf5b78d25.png[/img]
In order to allow more players to enjoy fighting game, Digital Crafter has put in some effort to design a new feature in Fight of Animals, by choosing “Assistant mode”, players can easily perform combos by simply smashing attack buttons. However, you will still get punishment when combos got block by opponent. 

For players who had fighting game experience can still use “Standard mode” in the game if they want more freedom in the match.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/bb49bd49218ccbe86879493a08812716bf0644a7.png[/img]

Fight of Animals has been design as an easy-get on style fighting game, in game tutorial has been provided and it’s super easy to learn!

《Fight of Animals》now has 6 playable animals. There will be more animals join the fight in the future.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/5014ba7cc2d980ba8d7a12a86b84b3f3017ac466.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/638a322ee147fd9c7e5ca798b752b5c9b23fe8c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36252601/34bf0ce6b3843866e26ece4485477763e9aeda9d.png[/img]

Fight of Animals is now on steam for only 6.99(USD) and 10% off for the releasing week! 

Official Twitter ：https://twitter.com/FightofAnimals/
Official Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/FightofAnimals/
